title: Which payment methods are accepted?
question: Which payment methods are accepted?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

title: Can I pay using PayPal?
question: Can I pay using PayPal?
answer: Yes, PayPal is available as a payment option at checkout.

title: Do you accept Apple Pay?
question: Do you accept Apple Pay?
answer: Yes, Apple Pay is supported on compatible devices at checkout.

title: Can I pay in installments?
question: Can I pay in installments?
answer: Yes, installment payments are available through our partnership with Klarna and Afterpay at checkout.

title: Why was my payment declined?
question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Declines commonly result from incorrect card details, insufficient funds, or your bank flagging the transaction.

title: Is it safe to enter my card details on your site?
question: Is it safe to enter my card details on your site?
answer: Yes, all payment data is encrypted and processed through PCI-compliant payment gateways.

title: Can I use a gift card and a credit card for the same order?
question: Can I use a gift card and a credit card for the same order?
answer: Yes, gift card balances are applied first, with any remaining balance charged to your card.

title: Do you accept cryptocurrency?
question: Do you accept cryptocurrency?
answer: We currently do not accept cryptocurrency as a payment method.

title: Will I be charged sales tax?
question: Will I be charged sales tax?
answer: Sales tax is calculated based on your shipping address and applicable state or local tax laws.

title: Can I save my payment information for future orders?
question: Can I save my payment information for future orders?
answer: Yes, you can securely save payment methods to your account for faster checkout.

title: What currency are prices displayed in?
question: What currency are prices displayed in?
answer: Prices are displayed in USD by default, with local currency conversion available for select countries.

title: When is my card actually charged?
question: When is my card actually charged?
answer: Your card is charged at the time of order placement, not at shipment.

title: Can I use multiple promo codes on one order?
question: Can I use multiple promo codes on one order?
answer: Only one promo code can be applied per order unless otherwise stated in the promotion terms.

title: Why do I see a pending charge before my order ships?
question: Why do I see a pending charge before my order ships?
answer: This is an authorization hold to confirm funds availability; it will finalize once your order ships.

title: Can I pay with a check or bank transfer?
question: Can I pay with a check or bank transfer?
answer: Online orders only accept digital payment methods; checks and bank transfers aren't supported.

title: What should I do if I was double charged?
question: What should I do if I was double charged?
answer: Contact support with your order number; duplicate charges are typically refunded within 3–5 business days after verification.

title: Do you accept international credit cards?
question: Do you accept international credit cards?
answer: Yes, international cards are accepted as long as they support online transactions.

title: Can I change my payment method after placing an order?
question: Can I change my payment method after placing an order?
answer: Payment methods cannot be changed after an order is placed; you'd need to cancel and reorder.

title: Is there a minimum order amount for installment payments?
question: Is there a minimum order amount for installment payments?
answer: Installment options typically require a minimum order value, usually around $35.

title: Why does my billing address need to match my card?
question: Why does my billing address need to match my card?
answer: Address verification helps prevent fraud and ensures your payment processes successfully.
